capabilities: Insert text snippets via a trigger character
Store snippets as files in a configured folder
Place the cursor with a %%cursor%% placeholder
Insert the last selected text into snippets
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; must be installed via BRAT or manually. Setup section repeats the snippet folder path instruction twice. Snippet examples include Dataview, callouts, HTML, tables, date snippets and AI templates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type a trigger character and expand reusable text snippets like callouts, tables or Dataview blocks in place.

relations.evidence: Enable Templater support if you want to use Templater syntax inside snippets.

summary: Slash-triggered snippet inserter that expands text snippets stored in a chosen folder while writing, with cursor placement, selection reuse and Templater support.
